LanguageData.ESP.alliesfleeTT: Do the same rules apply to any allies on your map? Default: False
LanguageData.ESP.nomessageTT: This will disable the 'X is injured and fleeing' message that shows up every time a pawn flees. Default: False
LanguageData.ESP.useoldTT: This make pawns use their current health instead of their current pain to trigger fleeing. Default: False
LanguageData.ESP.healthpercentTT: The percentage of health that will trigger fleeing in an average pawn. Pawns with the wimp trait will always flee when hurt. Default: 80
LanguageData.ESP.painpercentTT: The percentage of pain that will trigger fleeing in an average pawn. Pawns with the wimp trait will always flee when hurt. Default: 25
